description: React component for a modal dialog to delete a post or comment in Mattermost, handling user confirmation, warnings, and post-deletion navigation.

classes.name: DeletePostModal
classes.description: React component class for delete post modal dialog, managing state, user interactions, and post deletion logic.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a post, updates URL if necessary, and hides the modal upon success.

methods.name: handleEntered
methods.description: Focuses the delete button when modal is entered.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and refocuses the appropriate textbox if not on mobile.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the modal title based on whether the post is a comment or a main post.

methods.name: getPrompt
methods.description: Returns the confirmation prompt message based on post type.
